__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
This huge behemoth towers to a height of 15 feet.  He sneers at you
as he approaches and raises two black taloned claws to strike you.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A swamp troll charges towards you.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle troll

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
This big troll towers several feet over you.  He has a large spear
which he seems to ply with utmost prowess.  He jabs his spear at you
and cackles with glee.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A green troll attempts to get a hold on you.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle troll

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: This mean bastard looks like he could tear you limb from limb.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: An ogre stands here getting ready to beat in your face.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle ogre

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: The Swamp Thing has huge fists, which look like they could pound you flat.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The Swamp Thing shambles about here.  It seems hungry.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle thing

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: The Gnoll seems annoyed at your presence.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: There is a mean looking gnoll here.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle gnoll

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
This huge beast stands about 20 feet in height and has huge green clawed
appendages.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A huge hairy beast shambles towards you with death in his eyes.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle beast

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
This rather small beast looks like you could take it out with a single
sword blow.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A rather small beast cringes in terror as it notices you.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle beast

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
This strange little creature seems very hard to keep your eyes on.
You stare as hard as you can at the glowing ball of floating light and
are just able to notice a small pair of glowing eyes.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A Will-O-Wisp darts hear and there, making fun of you.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle will will-o-wisp

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: This 10 meter anaconda looks rather hungry.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A monstrous snake slithers towards you, thinking 'breakfast'.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle snake anaconda

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: It's the largest Amazon python you have ever seen.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A rather large python rests in a coil here.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle snake python

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
Yech!  She manages to make even Smurfette look attractive.  That's ok,
because she thinks you stink too, and she's about to do something about it.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle hag

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
This dark apparition stands a meager 13 feet in height.  Even in the dim
swamp light, the blade of his scythe gleams.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A Death Slaad is standing here distraught.  He seems lost.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle slaad

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
This wolf looks plump.  She probably ate a friend or two of yours who came
into the marsh.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A marsh wolf sniffs the ground has followed your scent.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle wolf

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: This grotesque pile of plant matter fills you with utmost horror.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A heap of garbage shambles towards you.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle mound shambling

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
This old orc has an array of bones stuck in his hair and strange symbols
painted on his face and hands.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: An orc shaman stands before you holding a staff and wearing robes.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle shaman orc

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: This huge monster of a man has green gnarly teeth and a BIG stick.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A marsh giant stomps towards you.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle giant

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: This creepy fellow looks like he could use you as a meal.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A large gargoyle lands next to you, baring his fangs at you.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle gargoyle
